rule_followed: a figure that cannot be scaled is unusable and is not guessed at
how_to_unblock: the environment's network policy denied the host. It is changed in the environment's settings (the cloud environment menu in the session's title bar, then Edit): either a broader access level, or pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov added under Allowed domains with 'Allow package managers' left ticked. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cloud-environments#network-access

khadanovich2023.figures_in_paper: heatmaps of the LACN/SBRN cross-sectional relationship to the cephalic vein, plus dissection photographs (named in the abstract)
khadanovich2023.why_not: not open access; no PMC id. Only the abstract is reachable.

qawasmi2024.figures_in_paper: cubital-fossa dissection photographs with the measured landmarks
qawasmi2024.why_not: not open access; no PMC id.

vonschroeder2001.why_not: not open access; no PMC id.

hu2009.figures_in_paper: CAL morphology and the conjoined-tendon transfer
hu2009.why_not: not open access, Chinese-language journal with an English abstract, and no DOI assigned.

nicholson1996.figures_in_paper: acromial morphology types I-III and outlet radiographs

raja2026.figures_in_paper: dissection photographs of the bilateral and the unilateral psoas minor
raja2026.why_not: open access, but `pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov` does not resolve from this session -- the host is outside the session's allowed network domains. The full-text channel that does work strips captions.

kosy2016.figures_in_paper: three figures: the isolated ALL with the LCL, GT and fibular head marked; the oblique fibre bundles under internal rotation; the meniscal attachment
kosy2016.why_not: the full text WAS read in full through the MCP channel and is the source of the lateral-femoral-epicondyle rule and the 37-59 mm published range -- but every caption came back as the bare token '(Fig.)', and PMC itself does not resolve from this session, so the images could not be inspected.
kosy2016.note: this paper's TEXT changed the construction (the femoral origin rule); its FIGURES did not.

rustagi2019.figures_in_paper: ALL dissection photographs with LCL and Gerdy's tubercle
rustagi2019.why_not: open access, but PMC does not resolve from this session.

verdict: The figure test could NOT be carried out in this session. Three of the eight sources are not open access at all; the other five are, but PubMed Central does not resolve here and the full-text channel that does work strips figure captions -- which is exactly where a scale bar or a stated magnification would be declared. No figure was scaled and NO number in this round comes from a figure. The nearest available substitute was the third test, where HRA / CCF publishes the anterolateral ligament of the knee as a real closed mesh with its triangle count and millimetre bounding size on the same two donors as the Imaging pages.
what_would_close_it: allow pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov and re-run; the five open-access sources' figures could then be inspected for a scale bar, and the two ALL papers' dissection photographs compared against the built ligament's femoral and tibial attachment positions.
